title: Amazing app, a true daily companion!
body:
This app is fantastic! It helps you plan your day based on your sleep and health data, showing your energy peaks and dips and suggesting the best times to get things done. (It even supports Garmin!) It’s a truly smart calendar that adapts to your energy levels.

It’s very convenient to use across both iOS and Windows, and the developer is very responsive, constantly improving the app and adding new features.

I’m really glad I discovered it, it’s now part of my daily routine! 💫
author: Helen.Moody
